Santa Mail is extra special this year

Let the magic begin

Our Animals, Our Country

A new stamp and coin collection by artist Ryhia Dank, celebrating Gudanji language and Country.

Explore the range

No ID? No worries.

Collect eligible parcels faster with App Collect and your QR code in the AusPost app.

Download the app now
StarTrack Business

Get it there, fast

Deliver to your customers quickly, securely and reliably with StarTrack’s same-day, next-day and express freight services.

Explore StarTrack

You can rely on Australia's largest delivery network

We deliver to every postcode in Australia, from major cities to remote outposts, covering over 12 million delivery points.

Personal

Explore our products and services for parcels and letters, passports, ID services, finance, travel insurance and more.  

Business

Explore our business and logistics offerings, backed by Australia’s largest lodgement network, to help your business grow. 

Delivery information

  • Delivery disruptions and service updates

    Get information on delivery delays, service updates, product recalls, price changes and more. 

  • Domestic delivery speeds and coverage

    View delivery speeds and coverage for sending parcels or letters within Australia. 

  • International delivery times and destination guide

    Get estimated delivery times and postage guidelines for 220+ international destinations. 

Buy our products online

Stock up on postage supplies and stamps, and browse our range of collectables and gifts. Multiple delivery and payment options available. 

Shop our range

Connecting communities and building resilience

Through our partnerships and programs, we’re bringing communities closer together to connect, grow and prosper.

Grants

Supporting community projects through grants

Find out how our Australia Post Grants programs have supported thousands of local organisations doing great work in their community. 

Mental health

Supporting mental wellbeing and connection

As a proud partner of Beyond Blue, we help connect Australians to mental health support.

Disaster relief

Helping communities affected by disasters

We help communities to prepare for, respond to and recover from disaster, in partnership with Australian Red Cross.

Literacy

Supporting Indigenous Literacy

In partnership with the Indigenous Literacy Foundation, we support First Nations Communities to connect with literacy, language and culture.

Environment

Regenerating nature

We’ve partnered with WWF-Australia to protect the habitat of endangered koalas and to regenerate nature.

Download the AusPost app to track, manage and collect your deliveries.
